tldr: Mercury in the 7th house: your mind and communication focus on partnership and one-to-one bonds
body: Mercury in the 7th house: your mind and communication focus on partnership and one-to-one bonds. Gift: sharp thinking there. Watch: overthinking it. With Mercury in the 7th house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through partnership, marriage, clients, contracts, and open conflict. This makes how you meet others, let yourself be met, and handle equality in relationship a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through one-to-one bonds.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in one-to-one bonds.
